def test_ttl_cache_timer_callable_used():
    class MockTimer:
        def __init__(self):
            self.value = 100

        def __call__(self):
            return self.value

    timer = MockTimer()
    wrapped = ttl_cache(maxsize=2, ttl=50, timer=timer)(lambda x: x)
    assert wrapped(1) == 1  # miss, stored at time 100
    assert wrapped(1) == 1  # hit (within ttl)
    timer.value = 200  # advance time to 200
    assert wrapped(1) == 1  # still within ttl? 200 - 100 = 100 > 50, should be expired
    # Actually, after time advances to 200, the entry is expired, so this should be a miss
    # But the function returns cached value only if not expired
    # Let's check actual behavior by looking at cache_info
    info = wrapped.cache_info()
    # First call: miss
    # Second call: hit (time 100 -> 100, diff 0 < 50)
    # Third call: time advanced to 200, call with arg 1: since 200 - 100 = 100 >= 50, expired -> miss
    # So we expect 2 misses, 1 hit
    assert info.misses == 2
    assert info.hits == 1
